summary: Cold codegen for chemical_detector: two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController) plus Vehicle, Sensor, ChangeDirection and system wiring. All 81 requirements are traced. 11 review items: invented constants and defaults, terminal-mode handling, and underspecified gas functions.

issues.title: Constant values are not given by the specification
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 say the constants are configured at startup but give no values.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm or replace THR=1.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=2, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=1 (time in Clock units). Small values were chosen deliberately to keep the formal model small.

issues.title: Gas analysis ends in a Concluded mode that discards later readings instead of a final state
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6: after stop the subsystem 'concludes its search, processing no further readings'. The codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: Concluded takes each further gas event (updating gs) and stays in Concluded without analysing it or emitting anything. Review whether this counts as 'processing no further readings'.

issues.title: Found stays put on obstacle reports; flag and halt happen on the stop transitions
issues.raw: CD-MV-Beh9/FR3: once in Found the subsystem stays halted. Found needs an outgoing transition, and flag must be emitted exactly once.
issues.fix_directive: Found's only transition is a self-loop on obstacle that records l and commands nothing. flag + move(0, Front) run on each of the six stop transitions, not on the self-loop, so the flag is not re-emitted.

issues.title: Meaning of 'indicates the target chemical' and where the target identity comes from
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 does not define 'indicates' and no requirement names the target chemical.
issues.fix_directive: analysis returns gasD iff some entry has c equal to the target Chem (a Sensor constructor argument set at startup) and i > 0.

issues.title: intensity/location range over all chemicals, not only the target
issues.raw: CD-Fn2/Fn3 define the peak over the whole sequence; CD-Fn1 is about the target chemical only.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally: peak over every entry. Restrict to target entries if a peak from another chemical should not steer or stop the robot.

issues.title: Sensor position to Angle mapping
issues.raw: CD-DM7 says the position encodes a direction but not which.
issues.fix_directive: Position 1..4 map to Left, Right, Back, Front (Angle declaration order), wrapping for longer arrays. Empty-reading defaults: noGas, 0, Front.

issues.title: Odometer is a sampled sensor value, not a triggering event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 lists the odometer as an event but describes the movement subsystem as sampling it into d0/d1.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor.odometer() is read on entry to Avoiding (d0) and on TryingAgain -> AvoidingAgain (d1).

issues.title: Intensity is a real (double), Chem is a record with a nat id
issues.raw: CD-DM4/DM5 describe opaque types. Java has no opaque ordered type.
issues.fix_directive: Intensity values are double and are compared through goreq (used in the threshold guard). Chem(int id) keeps equality-only use.

issues.title: Vehicle operations live on Vehicle; ChangeDirection is an operation class without compute()
issues.raw: CD-OP1..3 are provided by the Vehicle; CD-OP4 is steering logic that is conditional on l, so a compute() of plain assignments cannot express it.
issues.fix_directive: move/randomWalk/shortRandomWalk/pause are Vehicle methods; ChangeDirection.changeDirection(l) calls vehicle.move(LV, ...).

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: Only gs has a specified initial value (empty).
issues.fix_directive: sts=noGas, ins=0, anl=Front, a=Front, l=front, d0=d1=0, T=0.

issues.title: AvoidingAgain has no entry behaviour
issues.raw: CD-MV-FR6 lists no entry action; the robot is not steered away from the second obstacle until it returns to Avoiding.
issues.fix_directive: Nothing added beyond the requirements. The outgoing guards are exact complements (progress vs stuck), so the mode is always left on the next step.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers) and review the design choices above.
